source: 633 West Balam
target: 633 Occidens Balam

source: Lumian had heard from Lugano that ships deviating from the safe sea route might mysteriously disappear.
target: Lumian ab Lugano audiverat naves, quae a via marina tuta deviasterant, mirabiliter evanescere posse.

source: In a few years, they would occasionally appear at night–with no lights or people.
target: Paucis annis interdum nocte apparere solebant – sine luminibus aut hominibus.

source: This seemed to be the case now.
target: Hoc nunc casus esse videbatur.

source: In the past, Lumian might have teleported over out of curiosity, taking advantage of the three-masted sailboat’s reentry into a safe sea route to assess its internal condition.
target: Priore tempore, Lumian ex curiositate fortasse translocatus esset, terentem occasionem ut vetus triceps pinnatus vellere, quod ad viam marina tutae reditus pertineret, interius statum inspiceret.

source: However, after encountering the Demon legends on Hanth Island, he felt that less curiosity was better.
target: Sed postquam de legendis daemonum in insula Hanth audiverat, sensit minus curiositatis melius esse.

source: As long as the uninhabited ship traveling in the darkness didn’t exhibit signs of attack or an imminent danger, he could treat it as a unique spectacle of the Berserk Sea and simply observe.
target: Dummodo nave in tenebris errans, quae incolāta esset, signa hostilitatis aut imminenti periculo non ostenderet, eam singularem spectaculum Maris Berserki agnosceret et tantum observaret.

source: The brown ship gradually distanced itself, leaving only the billowing sails in its wake.
target: Navis fusca paulatim remotam esse videbatur, relinquens solum velis inflatis vestigia sua.

source: Abruptly, Lumian, utilizing his exceptional vision, spotted a face silently staring out of an open hole in the cabin’s uppermost window.
target: Subito, Lumian, singulari visu utebatur, et vultum ex nigro foramine aperturae fenestræ summæ cellæ tacite aspicientem animadvertit.

source: The face, shriveled and pale-white, clung tightly to the bones, devoid of flesh and blood.
target: Vultus, contritus et pallide albus, ad ossa arcte adhaerebat, carentem carne et sanguine.

source: Flaxen-colored hair cascaded like withered weeds.
target: Capilli flavicantes quasi herbae exaridae fluere videbantur.

source: The eyeballs were absent, leaving only a void of deep darkness.
target: Oculi absentes erant, relinquentes solum vacuum tenebrarum infimarum.

source: It resembled the head of a desiccated corpse, yet its lips were surprisingly vibrant, as if recently adorned with lipstick.
target: Habet similitudo capitis cadaveris exsiccati, attamen labiis prorsus vivacibus, quasi nuper labello depictis, ornata.

source: Lumian instinctively sensed the face belonged to a woman.
target: Lumian intuitu suo quasi sanente sensit vultum ad feminam pertinere.

source: At least, she had been a woman when alive.
target: Saltem, illa femina vixit.

source: He refrained from raising his right hand for a warm greeting.
target: Non levavit dextram manum ad salutem calidam offerendam.

source: Instead, he quietly observed as the ancient three-masted sailboat sailed beyond the safe sea route and into the dark night.
target: Pro eo, tacite intuens perspexit veterem triceps pinnatum vellere ultra viam marina tutae navigare atque in noctem obscuram ingredi.

source: The desiccated face, with blood‑red lips and pitch‑black eyes, blended into the darkness.
target: Vultus exsiccatus, labiis sanguine rubris et oculis atris perfecta, in tenebris evanuit.

source: Only then did Lumian wave his hand and offer a faint smile.
target: Tunc tantum Lumian manum agitavit et levem subrisum intulit.

source: “Goodbye! You won’t be missed!”
target: „Vale! Te non desiderabimus!”

source: He then helped Franca and the others to devise a plan to confront Moran Avigny.
target: Deinde Francae aliisque consilium componere ad Moran Avigny oppugnandum adiuvavit.

source: Ultimately, he opted to await further information from 007 before finalizing their strategy.
target: Denique statuendum esse statuit ut ulterius ab 007 notitia acciperetur antequam consilium finaliter ficeretur.

source: Conspirer wasn’t a visionary, known for conjuring conspiracies out of thin air; they required substantial information as a foundation.
target: Conspirator non erat visionarius, qui ex nihilo coniurationes excitaret; informatione solida ut fundamento necessaria erant.

source: When Lumian awoke at dawn, the Berries emerged from the dense, death‑carrying fog of the Berserk Sea.
target: Cum Lumian aurora expergisceretur, Berries ex densa nebula morte ferente Maris Berserki emerserunt.

source: Before him stretched a clear blue sea, bathed in the intense sunlight of the high sky.
target: Ante eum extendebatur mare caeruleum lucidum, intenso sole caeli altissimi illustratum.

source: The next day, the Berries bypassed Behrens Harbor at the northernmost tip of West Balam.
target: Die sequenti, Berries portum Behrens in extremo boreali West Balam transierunt.

source: Instead, they continued southwest, reaching Port Pylos by 4 p.m.
target: Immo in australem occidentem pergentes, ad Portum Pylos ad horam quartam post meridiem pervenerunt.

source: Situated in Matani, the port was under the rule of Admiral Querarill.
target: Portus, in Matani sito, sub imperio Admiralis Querarill erat.

source: Originally a colony of the Intis Republic, Port Pylos saw Intis colonists withdraw after the war a few years ago.
target: Colonia olim Reipublicae Intis, Portus Pylos vidit colones Intis post bellum paucis annis abhinc se recedisse.

source: Subsequently, various factions from the Feynapotter Kingdom, maintaining a favorable relationship with Admiral Querarill, took control.
target: Deinde, varia factiones ex regno Feynapotter, relationem benecum Admirali Querarill servantes, imperium ceperunt.

source: Lumian’s target, Hisoka, was yet to surface in Port Pylos, but Lumian knew that the two pranks he had engaged in were in Matani.
target: Meta Lumiani, Hisoka, in Portu Pylos adhuc apparuisse non videbatur, sed Lumian sciebat duo iocos, quos in Matani egisset, fuisse.

source: One occurred in Tizamo Town, at the outskirts of Port Pylos, closest to the forest, and the other in Devise, the southernmost gold mine city in Matani.
target: Unus evenit in oppido Tizamo, in limine Portus Pylos, prope silvam, et alter in Devise, urbe fodinaria auri meridionali Matani.

source: As Lumian unbuttoned the second button on his linen shirt, he remarked to Lugano in a self‑deprecating tone,
target: Dum Lumian secundum nodum in veste linteo evolvens erat, ad Lugano, tono sibi ipsi humili, dixit:

source: “I feel like I’m shunned by winter and have been living in a scorching environment.”
target: „Sentio quasi hieme reiectus sim et in ambitu ardenti vixerim.”

source: Having arrived in Port Santa during late autumn, which was relatively hot and sunny, Lumian moved on to Port Colla as Port Santa began to cool.
target: Postquam Portum Santaei in autumno serotino, qui calidum et solis plenum erat, attigit, Lumian ad Portum Colla se contulit, cum Portus Santaei refrigerari coepit.

source: His journey continued through what his sister called the tropics, devoid of winter and maintaining a temperature of at least around 20 degrees Celsius.
target: Iter eius per spatium, quod soror sua “tropica” appellavit, sine hieme et cum recta temperatura—saltem circa viginti gradus—pergebat.

source: While Trier was already in midwinter, the Southern Continent was experiencing the height of summer.
target: Dum Trier iam in media hieme versabatur, Continens Meridionalis culmen aestatis experiebatur.

source: This made Lumian’s specially prepared black tweed coat and Gehrman‑styled trench coat impractical.
target: Hoc efficiebat ut pallium ex nigro tweed specialiter praeparatum et mantellum trench, more Gehrman, incommoda videbantur.

source: “Because we’ve been traveling south all autumn,” Lugano declared authoritatively on matters of weather and seasons.
target: „Quia totum autumno ad meridiem iter fecimus,” dixerat Lugano cum auctoritate de tempestatibus et temporibus.

source: Lumian donned a golden straw hat and strolled down the gangway to the port, hand in hand with Ludwig.
target: Lumian pileum stramineum aureum induit et per viam navalem ad portum ambulavit, manum in manum cum Ludwig.

source: He boldly embodied the traits of the adventurer Louis Berry.
target: Audacter virtutes viatoris Ludovici Berry exhibuit.

source: Initially, Lumian had contemplated altering his strategy, adopting a new identity to discreetly investigate the two pranks in Matani and uncover Hisoka without drawing attention.
target: Initio, Lumian consilium mutandi rationem suam meditatus est, novam identitatem assumentem ad arcane duas iocas in Matani perscrutandas atque Hisokam detegendam, ne ullam attentionem susciperet.

source: However, after Franca vividly detailed Hisoka’s usual characteristics to Anthony Reid, the Hypnotist’s profiling revealed an exceptionally aggressive trait, ranking among the top.
target: Tamen, postquam Franca nitide notas consuetas Hisoka ad Antonium Reid enarravit, indagatio hypnosi demonstravit notam eximie aggressivam, inter praecipuas numeratam.

source: As a result, Lumian reconsidered and returned to his role of casting out “bait.”
target: Propterea, Lumian iterum meditatus est et ad munus suum “escam eiciendi” redegit.

source: Yet, he couldn’t shake the feeling that success was a slim possibility.
target: Attamen sensum non absolvit, quod successus vix contingere posset.

source: The sea sacrificial ritual and Loki’s survival had likely provided Hisoka with a comprehensive understanding of the factions backing him.
target: Ritualis marinus sacrificii atque superstitia Loki verisimiliter Hisokae plenam intellegentiam de factionibus, quae eum sustinebant, contulerunt.

source: April Fool’s, with its former display of resources and energy, seemed ill‑equipped to challenge the might of the Tarot Club.
target: April Fool’s, pristino opum et energiae ostensione, vix idoneus apparuit potentiam Tarot Club oppugnandi.

source: And Lumian wasn’t solely relying on the Tarot Club for support.
target: Nec tantum Tarot Club subsidio Lumian innitebatur.

source: If he were in Hisoka’s shoes, Lumian would opt for patience.
target: Si in pedibus Hisoka versaretur, Lumian patientiam optasset.

source: He’d wait a month or two, allowing the vengeful enemy to grow restless and make mistakes.
target: Mensis vel duo exspectaret, sinens hostem ultionis inquietari et errores committere.

source: When the formidable forces behind him could no longer guarantee protection, he’d launch a surprise attack.
target: Cum copiae formidabiles, quae eum sustinebant, tutelam praestare amplius non poterant, impetum insperatum proferret.

source: For now, let’s not devise a plan.
target: Pro tempore, consilium non constituamus.

source: “I’ll consider it when I find clues,” Lumian muttered to himself.
target: „Id considerabo, cum indicia inveniam,” Lumian sibi ipsi submurmuravit.

source: Leaving the port alongside a throng of passengers, he reached the public carriage stop.
target: Portum relinquens simul cum multitudo vecturarum, ad stativam coccionis publicae pervenit.

source: Numerous rental carriages and pitch‑black or vermilion coffins were parked nearby.
target: Multae carrucae conductionis et sarcophagī nigerrimi vel coccineī prope statuta erant.

source: Coffins? Despite having read many travelog books on West Balam’s customs, Lumian found it absurd to witness coffins lining the roadside.
target: Sarcophagī? Quamquam multas de moribus West Balam in libris itinerum legerat, Lumian absurdum invenit videre sarcophagos viam ornantes.

source: Before the invasion of the Northern Continent, before East and West Balam’s division, the Balam Empire revered Death—
target: Ante invasionem Continenti Septentrionalis, ante divisionem Balam Orientalis et Occidentalis, Imperium Balam Mortem venerabatur—

source: the Emperor of the Underworld from the War of the Four Emperors.
target: Imperator Inferorum ex Bello Quattuor Imperatorum.

source: Thus, the locals valued and loved coffins, considering them objects that brought peace, tranquility, and the blessing of Death.
target: Ita, incolae sarcophagos aestimabant et amabant, existimantes eos res esse quae pacem, tranquillitatem et Mortis benedictionem afferant.

source: When traveling, they would lie inside, carried by people or pulled by horses and single‑horned goats.
target: Iter facientes intus iaciebant, aut a hominibus portati aut equis et capris cum uno cornu tractati.

source: Of course, this form of transportation was reserved for those of a certain wealth level.
target: Certe, haec forma vecturae reservata erat illis, qui opes certæ habebant.

source: Ordinary people couldn’t even afford lying in a coffin.
target: Populi ordinarii ne in sarcophago iacere quidem se praestare poterant.

source: After a momentary daze, Lumian addressed Lugano and Ludwig with interest, “Do you want to take the coffin? I plan to give it a try.”
target: Post brevem stupefactionem, Lumian ad Lugano et Ludwig cum studio dixit: “Sarcofagum capere vultis? Ego id conari cogito.”

source: “I-I’ll pass,” Lugano replied, finding the idea of lying in a coffin unsettling.
target: “Ego praetermittam,” respondit Lugano, sentiens ideam in sarcophago iacendi perturbantem esse.

source: Ludwig shifted his attention to the nearby street vendors.
target: Ludwig animos suos ad venditores viarios prope convertere constituit.

source: The aroma of corn and potatoes intertwined, enticing every passerby and prompting increased saliva production.
target: Odor frumenti et solani mixtus, quemque transeuntem allicit et salivarum productionem incitat.

source: “How lame,” Lumian teased with a smile.
target: “Quam ineptus,” arridens Lumian iocose inquit.

source: Approaching the four locals with disheveled black hair and dark brown skin, he raised his right hand and pointed at the pitch‑black coffin beneath the shade of a tree.
target: Accedens ad quattuor incolas, qui capillis disiectis et cute fusca essent, dextram manum elevavit et ad sarcophagum nigerrimum sub umbra arboris demonstravit.

source: “How much?” Lugano inquired in fluent Dutanese before Lumian could.
target: “Quantum?” inquirivit Lugano, lingua Dutana fluente, antequam Lumian responderet.

source: “How much?” Lugano inquired in fluent Dutanese before Lumian could.
target: “Quantum?” inquirivit iterum Lugano, in lingua Dutana fluente, antequam Lumian interveneret.

source: His linguistic talent was evident.
target: Ars linguistica eius manifesta erat.

source: Less than a month had passed since their departure from Port Santa to their arrival at Port Pylos, and he could already communicate with people in Dutanese.
target: Minus quam mensis transiit ex Portu Santa ad Portum Pylos, atque iam cum hominibus lingua Dutana communicare poterat.

source: Of course, his proficiency was limited to basic words and short sentences.
target: Certe, eius peritia ad verba fundamentalia et sententias breves restricta erat.

source: A half‑naked local in linen pants replied in Dutanese,
target: Localis semi nudus in braccis linteis respondit in lingua Dutana,

source: “Nearby, 40 coppet; faraway, 1 verl d’or.”
target: “Prope, 40 coppet; longe, 1 verl d’or.”

source: Recognizing the foreigner’s inquiry, he refrained from quoting the price in the local currency, Delexi, the Intisian term for copper coins.
target: Cum quaestionem alienam agnovit, abstinuit pretium in monetis localibus, Delexi, vocato Intisiano pro nummis cupreis, indicare.

source: Quite affordable.
target: Valde parabile.

source: This coffin, carried by four people, should be considerably cheaper than the one carried by eight… Lumian mused, appreciating the direct use of verl d’or and coppet.
target: Hic sarcophagus, a quattuor fertus, multo vilior esse debet quam ille, a octo portatus… meditatus est Lumian, directum usum verl d’or et coppet laude afferens.

source: It showcased the recent Intisian influence in the former colony, lost only a few years ago.
target: Id demonstravit recentem influentiam Intisianam in colonia pristina, intra paucos annos amisso.

source: Lumian’s grasp of Dutanese surpassed Lugano’s, thanks to the mid‑level Language Comprehension charm he had used on the ship.
target: Peritia Lumiani in lingua Dutana Luganum superabat, gratia incantationis medio gradus “Language Comprehension” quam in nave usus erat.

source: Learning Dutanese in this manner proved more efficient.
target: Doctrina linguae Dutanae hoc modo efficius fuit.

source: Regarding charm consumption, Lumian harbored no concerns.
target: De incantationum consumptione, Lumian nihil sollicite habebat.

source: In his view, items served a purpose, and there was no concept of waste as long as they proved useful.
target: Secundum eius opinionem, res utilitati destinatae erant, nec conceptus vastitatis exsistebat, dummodo utiles proessebant.

source: He couldn’t align with those miserly individuals who hoarded their wealth throughout life, only for it to benefit others after their demise.
target: Non consentiebat cum illis parvo animo hominibus, qui divitias suas per vitam colebat, ut solummodo post mortem aliis prosent.

source: If he urgently needed Language Comprehension charms, he could acquire them from the Curly‑Haired Baboons Research Society.
target: Si celeriter incantationibus “Language Comprehension” opus haberet, ea comparare posset ex Societate Papionum Capillitibus Crispis.

source: If their gathering didn’t align with his schedule, teleporting to various cities in Lenburg would allow him to purchase them from the Church of Knowledge.
target: Si conventus eorum cum suo tempore non congruabat, teleportando ad varias urbes in Lenburg ea ab Ecclesia Cognitionis emere poterat.

source: “Sure,” Lumian nodded at Lugano and said, “Let’s go to Hotel Orella.”
target: „Certe,” annuit Lumian ad Lugano et dixit: „Eamus ad Hospitium Orella.”

source: After Lugano paid 1 verl d’or, the local who had quoted the price lifted the thin coffin lid, revealing the interior covered with thick dark‑red cloth and a stiff neck pillow.
target: Postquam Lugano 1 verl d’or solvit, incola, qui pretium enumeraverat, tenue operculum sarcophagi levavit, revelans interiorem tegumentum densā panno nigro‑rubro et pulvinar rigido colli constitutum.

source: Excitedly, Lumian removed his golden straw hat and lay down, immediately feeling a cooling sensation enveloping his body.
target: Exsultans, Lumian pileum stramineum aureum abstulit et se iacuit, statim sensu refrigerii, qui corpus suum amplectebatur, percepit.

source: In the hot season, the coffin effectively dispelled the humidity.
target: In aestate, sarcophagus efficaciter humiditatem exstinxit.

source: Is it the coffin’s wood or the sun‑screening black paint, or perhaps the shade of the tree? It feels like stepping into a morgue in the summer—surprisingly comfortable…
target: Numne lignum sarcophagi, an nigra pinguedo solis tegente, aut fortasse umbra arboris? Videtur quasi in morgheum aestate introire—mirum tamen commodum…

source: Lumian observed the thin coffin lid closing, witnessing the shadows rapidly expanding until they dominated his world.
target: Lumian tenue operculum sarcophagi claudens aspexit, umbras celeriter dilatantes usque ad orbem suum dominandum.

source: Outside, the voices became muffled in his ears.
target: Extra, voces in auribus eius obmutescebantur.

source: The coffin was lifted, swaying slightly as it moved forward.
target: Sarcophagus sublatus est, leviter oscillans dum procedebat.

source: Within Lumian’s view, everything was dark, and his surroundings exuded a sinister, cold ambiance.
target: In conspectu Lumiani, omnia obscura erant, atque ambitus eius atmosphaeram sinistram et frigidam efferebat.

source: For some reason, it felt like he was walking toward death, touching it.
target: Aliqua rei causa, videbatur se versus mortem ambulare, eam attingens.

source: Setting aside the psychological discomfort, it isn’t bad.
target: Incommoda psychologica praetermittens, non male videtur.

source: The only downside is the tendency to easily fall asleep… Lumian evaluated the mode of transportation in a good mood.
target: Unum tantum incommodum erat, quod facile ad somnum incidere valebat… Lumian modum vecturae in animo laeto aestimavit.

source: It’s unsuitable for mixed‑gender rides, which could be more awkward.
target: Non idoneum est ad vecturas generum mixtarum, quae fortasse magis incommoda esse possent.

source: Heh heh, I wonder if the “romantic” Intisians have ever engaged in an affair under such circumstances?
target: Heh heh, miror an Intisiani “romantici” umquam sub talibus condicionibus rem amoris gesserint.

source: Nearly half an hour later, the coffin halted in front of Hotel Orella.
target: Fere dimidio hora post, sarcophagus ante Hospitium Orella sistit.

source: Lumian stepped out, finding himself in front of a small, man‑made valley.
target: Lumian egressus est, se coram parva valle artificio facta inveniens.

source: Rows of grayish‑black stone rooms encircled the inner wall of the “deep valley” until reaching the bottom.
target: Sera cellarum lapidearum fuscorum et cinereorum internam murum “vallis profundae” circumdabant, donec ad imum perveniebant.

source: This was Port Pylos’s most renowned Hotel Orella.
target: Id erat Hotel Orella, notissimum Portus Pylos.

source: Originally belonging to a Balam royal family descendant, Orella Eggers, it had been constructed with the intent of approaching death.
target: Primitivē, pertinens ad descendentem familiae regiae Balam, Orella Eggers, constructum est ad mortem appropinquare.

source: Later, it fell into the hands of Intis colonists.
target: Postea in manibus colonorum Intis cecidit.

source: Upon the Feynapotterians’ arrival, they perceived it as a symbol of entering the earth and returning to the land, prompting its transformation into a sizable hotel.
target: Cum Feynapotteriani advenerunt, id ut signum ingrediendi terram et redire ad ager perceptum est, quod conversionem eius in magnum hospitium impulit.
